block.guhs.bank_guh.lore: So chonky that all sorts of stuff fits in their tummy: a whole %s of each kind!
entity.guhs.quest_guh.thanks: Nom nom nom! Thank you! Here, take my buddy the Bank Guh - they'll eat anything, a whole 256 of each kind!
structure.guhs.barbecueput.tooltip: Broken barbecues with a grill coal frame. The Grill Guh only lives in a big pit: in new land it sits in the middle of a Nibble Shire (also in this list)
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.grillguh: Rarity: Rare (big Barbecue Pit; in new land in the middle of a Nibble Shire)
gui.guhs.klus.farmen.tip: Harvests ripe crops and replants them right away: wheat, carrots, potatoes, beetroots, cheese nibble plants, peppers and guh gardens. Also pumpkins, melons, sugar cane, cocoa, nether wart and peanut and mustard sprouts. Waters thirsty gardens. (Guhs)
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.klus.farmen.ge: No crops, guh gardens, pumpkins, sugar cane or sprouts
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.klus.farmen.no: a little field of crops (wheat, carrots, potatoes, beetroots, cheese nibble plants, peppers...) or a planted guh garden in the chore area. Ripe ones get harvested and replanted, a thirsty garden gets water. Also: pumpkins and melons on their stem (the stem stays), sugar cane (the bottom piece stays), ripe cocoa they can reach, nether wart, and from every peanut or mustard sprout plant one sprout per 5 minutes (the plant stays put).
No chest, Bank Guh or Nom Hatch to put the stuff in
a chest next to the house, a Bank Guh in the chore area or a working Nom Hatch in the chore area. Then they pick up whatever lies on the ground in the chore area.
gui.guhs.verhalen.grillguh.nu.0: Talk to the Grill Guh by the big Barbecue Pit (in new land: in the middle of a Nibble Shire).
gui.guhs.verhalen.grillguh.waar.0: The Grill Guh by the big Barbecue Pit (Guhmension: also in the middle of a Nibble Shire; or in the Barbecuether)
block.guhs.guh_oven.lore: No coal or charcoal needed: it bakes on chonk power! Put it next to a Guh Wheel with a guh running in it, or hook it up with Guh Wire. It doesn't care for plain redstone.
gui.guhs.guh_oven.aan: Chonk power! The oven is baking.
gui.guhs.guh_oven.uit: The oven isn't baking. It needs chonk power: put it next to a Guh Wheel with a guh running in it, or hook it up with Guh Wire (and put something in it to bake). Look at the oven and you'll read whether your setup has enough chonk power.
ftb.guhs_basis.q.wheel.desc: Put your tame guh in a &dGuh Wheel&r: it runs up &dchonk power&r for your guh machines, and it never gets tired. A happy little guh runs extra fast! &dGuh Wire&r carries the chonk power to your machines. Look at the wheel or the wire and you'll read how much chonk power your setup uses. Nyeg!
ftb.guhs_basis.q.guh_oven.title: Baking on Chonk Power
ftb.guhs_basis.q.guh_oven.desc: A &dGuh Oven&r (8 cobblestone around a cheese nibble) needs no coal: it bakes on &dchonk power&r! Put it next to a &dGuh Wheel&r with a guh running in it, or hook it up with &dGuh Wire&r. Look at the oven and you'll read how much chonk power your setup uses: if it asks for more than your guhs run up together, everything stands still. It doesn't care for plain redstone. The little guh runs, the oven bakes. Nyeg!
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.bank_plaatsen.desc: Put your &dBank Guh&r down and click it: a whole &e256&r of each kind fits in its tummy (with the Inventor Guh's &dBottomless Nibble Belly&r even endless amounts). You can search, sort and filter, and it has a crafting grid (with JEI, the &e+&r fills the grid from the bank first). Is it in the chore area of a Guh House? Then the residents sort everything they collect into it. Break it and it takes everything along.
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.bbq_put.desc: Somewhere in the Guhmension there are broken barbecues with half a Grill Coal frame: the &6Barbecue Pits&r. The Super Compass (Barbecue > Barbecue Pit) shows the way. The big one, the Grill Guh's, sits in new land in the middle of a &6Nibble Shire&r (Barbecue > Nibble Shire).
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.bbq_grillguh.des: The &dGrill Guh&r sits in the &6big Barbecue Pit&r. In new land that pit lies in the middle of a &6Nibble Shire&r: the Super Compass (Barbecue > Nibble Shire) shows the way. The Mikas swiped his Fire Starter Cubes! Talk to him.
